title: Remove redundant QUIET_INIT MovePicker stage
rationale: FayE main still contains the redundant QUIET_INIT stage removed by upstream PR #7150. The patch removes one enum stage and the redundant stage increment/fallthrough without changing move generation or ordering semantics.
promotion_rule: Adopted as a semantics-preserving maintenance cleanup rather than as a strength gain; the flat 400-game screen is not evidence of Elo improvement.
next: Begin separate behavior-preserving whole-codebase modernization; do not attribute modernization changes to Elo. After modernization correctness/performance gates pass, proceed to FAYE-0008.

result.rationale: Promoted as a no-functional-change MovePicker cleanup. The paired strength screen was essentially flat, so no strength improvement is claimed. Identical functional bench nodes passed, and the adopted code change only removes the redundant QUIET_INIT stage/control-flow step.

promotion.code_change: Remove redundant QUIET_INIT MovePicker stage and fallthrough increment.
